The 30-Decision Problem
You probably won't remember the 30 small decisions you made today.

But together, they shaped your day.

What to open.

What to postpone.

What to answer.

What to ignore.

What to work on.

What to interrupt.

That's why we're interested in decision patterns, not just completed tasks.
